reviews.text:
Great App!. I don’t usually pay for apps, but after trying the free version I realised how useful it was and decided to upgrade. I kept practising until I could get every question right, and when I sat my theory I scored 50/50.

The hazard perception practice was a lifesaver too. At the start I was awful, but after a bit of practice I was getting full marks and in the real test I got 67/75. There were a couple of questions on the day that weren’t in the app, but because I knew the rest so well I was able to work them out. Would definitely recommend this app if you want to pass first time.
